'''Gunder Vren''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] program the [[Shard of Alderaan]] was stolen from the Alliance by the criminal entrepreneur [[Begas Tok]], Tok attempted to auction the program aboard the [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] ''[[Dune Princess]]'' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Vren attended the sale in an attempt to recover the program, but after a sandstorm erupted, Vren was trapped aboard the barge while several other Rebel agents waited for him in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="The Shard of Alderaan" />
